defect: asynchronous grouping is appropriate for independent islands
rationale: The oscillators are independent and there are no data paths between their internal states; grouping them asynchronous matches the architecture. Startup initial blocks express FPGA initialization; plain edge-triggered always procedures preserve it without violating always_ff single-writer restrictions.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.note: The clocks are independent with no crossings, and outputs are constrained to their own clocks.
